results.title: Ingeborg Bachmann – Someone Who Was Once Me
results.original_title: Ingeborg Bachmann – Jemand, der einmal ich war
results.overview: Sandra Hüller portrays Ingeborg Bachmann on an imaginary day in Rome. Regina Schilling’s hybrid film weaves together reenactments, archival footage, and Bachmann’s own writings into a portrait that offers a refreshing new perspective on the author and positions her writings as a reference point in current debates on gender relations and power.

results.title: Emi Martínez: The Kid Who Stops Time
results.original_title: Dibu Martínez: El pibe que ataja el tiempo
results.overview: Mixing animation and interviews, this film follows Emi Martínez's journey to becoming a legendary goalkeeper, from small-town Argentina to world glory.

results.title: NJPW New Japan Cup 2026 - Day 1
results.overview: The opening night of New Japan Cup 2026 took place on March 4, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan, marking the start of New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW)’s annual heavyweight single-elimination tournament and featured two first-round matches.

results.title: Chimera
results.overview: A private investigator takes on a missing child's case that draws a striking resemblance to the abduction of his own sister.

results.title: Marcello Hernández: American Boy
results.overview: Filmed in Miami, Hernández's special features his comedic take on his first-generation American upbringing before a local audience.

results.title: Noumena
results.overview: Noumena tells the story of one date between two twenty somethings who went to high school together and now reconnect via a dating app at a bar in their hometown of Brooklyn, NY.

results.title: Separate Ways
results.overview: The story follows Leah, a resilient young woman navigating a world reshaped by a sudden and terrifying outbreak. As society collapses and the threat of the undead looms, Leah struggles not only to survive the new dangers around her but also to process the emotional weight of her past. Through haunting flashbacks, we glimpse her relationship with Mason-her longtime partner-and the unresolved tensions, love, and missed moments that defined their life before everything changed. Blending intimate relationship drama with apocalyptic horror, the film explores how ordinary human conflicts are magnified in extraordinary circumstances. As Leah moves between memories of what once was and the harsh reality of what now is, she's forced to confront loss, love, and the difficult choices that come with survival.

results.title: Awakening: The Fight for Israel's Democracy
results.overview: When Israel is hijacked from within by extremist political forces, a group of citizens transform overnight into protest leaders. They embark on an epic struggle for their democracy - one that pushes the nation to the brink of civil war. Then war does break out, and the stakes rise even higher.

results.title: Sippiyan Sitaare
results.overview: Determined to become a top fashion designer, small-town dreamer Jagga moves to the bustling city and joins quiet tailor Samar. When sudden hardships threaten their venture, the duo must unite to rebuild their shared dream.

results.title: Paradeisa
results.overview: Struggling to keep their family together, Lou helps her broke artist father fake his own death to boost the value of his work. But as the lie of cat litter ashes grows, she realises that letting go might be the only way forward.

results.title: Miss Representation: Rise Up
results.overview: MISS REPRESENTATION: RISING dives deep into the cultural backlash against women’s mental health, agency, and political power with technology exacerbating sexism and misogyny towards women and girls.

results.title: What Love Builds
results.overview: Follows Crowe's passion for music and his efforts of maintaining it alongside his acting career, showcasing him and his band on their recent tour in Europe, as well as previous shows in the US, UK and Australia.

results.title: Band Practice
results.overview: A New Orleans majorette and her band geek best friend attempt to check item #1 off their senior year bucket list: KISS GIRLS.

results.title: Nagabandham: The Secret Treasure
results.overview: A chosen warrior protects a mystical, serpent-bound Himalayan temple from those seeking to steal the power of the Brahma Kamalam, a divine relic.

results.title: Drömmen om VM – inifrån herrlandslagets playoff
results.original_title: Drömmen om VM – inifrån herrlandslagets playoff
results.overview: Follow the Swedish men's national football team behind the scenes during the decisive playoff campaign — from the match against Ukraine in Valencia to the final against Poland in front of a sold-out Strawberry Arena. The night when Viktor Gyökeres scored the late winner and the World Cup dream became reality.

results.title: Manhood
results.overview: “Manhood” follows Dallas entrepreneur Bill Moore as he attempts to make penis enlargement as commonplace as Botox. Along the way, an OnlyFans star and a father of five put their bodies — and their insecurities — on the line. Blending dark humor with unexpected empathy, “Manhood” examines shame, addiction, and the fragile myths of American masculinity.

results.title: Taming the Beast
results.overview: The world strongest man learns how to embrace his mental health challenges by confronting his inner demons and dealing with his biggest failure to date which ultimately changes his life.

results.title: Goody Goody
results.overview: During a prolonged home birth trapped by a raging blizzard, expecting parents and their midwife begin to suspect something sinister is lurking nearby as labor complications escalate and their sense of safety unravels.
